behavioral_indicators: internal host or service enumeration after an adversary has gained access
port and service probes across hosts inside the victim environment
lateral network scanning used to identify reachable systems and services
Nmap or another scanner enumerating open ports from an internal source

positive_evidence.reason: The normalized event is a network scan.
The action represents active service enumeration.
Rule-name terminology explicitly supports this technique, but signature text and tool names are positive evidence rather than a required gate.

negative_evidence.reason: Inbound pre-compromise scanning is more consistent with T1595.
The signature frames the activity as external reconnaissance.

exclusion_indicators.reason: This event type does not establish service discovery.

current_technique_when: The scan is internal, lateral, or explicitly post-compromise.
other_technique_when: The scan is inbound external reconnaissance before access.

T1046.retrieval_text: Technique: T1046 Network Service Discovery. Internal or lateral port and service enumeration after access. Detect internal port scans, service probes, Nmap activity, and post-compromise discovery. Distinguish from T1595 Active Scanning, which is inbound pre-compromise reconnaissance.
